title: fix: correct Sonnet 5.5 cached input pricing
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected Claude Sonnet 5.5’s cached-input price, billed in Pollen per million cached input tokens, to match its Bedrock provider cost. Paid-only access, the other prices, capabilities, and lack of a fallback are unchanged. Updated the effective-price test snapshot.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden workspace, Polli adjusts a small cached-token price tag beside a glowing lime green (#ecf874) terminal while a code-plant grows nearby; she wears tiny accountant glasses and shares the scene with the desk. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
